question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a yellow ball, Bob has a teal ball, and Claire has a blue ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Claire and Bob swap balls. Then, Bob and Claire swap balls. Finally, Claire and Alice swap balls. At the end of the game, Alice has the
Options:
(A) yellow ball
(B) teal ball
(C) blue ball
solution:
Ball colors are listed in order (Alice, Bob, Claire).
Initial: (yellow, teal, blue)
1. Claire and Bob swap: (yellow, blue, teal)
2. Bob and Claire swap: (yellow, teal, blue)
3. Claire and Alice swap: (blue, teal, yellow)
Alice has the blue ball, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
